display_name: Phase1 continuous physical mixture source validation
description: Fixed source-only validation of learned continuous six-component physical IQ posterior mixture against blind posterior parent and DURA.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU0 source-only fixed model evaluation; TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], blind physical posterior and source-trained continuous six-hypothesis IQ mixture
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No source true identity labels, simulated channel truth, U_s truth, V or test in this validation; clean-F pseudo labels only
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout IDs, all physical IDs previously observed in other views; frozen clean F pseudo labels only

permissions.query_use: Only source fit L_s truth and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo targets; no U_s truth/V/test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-trained mixture controller, blind channel, six-component source prior, ground F and gate; DURA only a comparator.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact source training run c67dc6d7b6a3880ffe2fe4e49357ee4da18eb4ef; blind epoch10 source model and 8192-ID source prior; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed scales 0.5/1/2 and gates 0.8/0.99; RX4/6 classification and IQ guards against parent and DURA, net improvement >=10; RX8 heldout observation; no automatic target test.
